description: A React component class 'TeamList' for displaying and managing a list of teams in the Mattermost admin console, including search, filtering, pagination, and navigation.

classes.name: TeamList
classes.description: A React.PureComponent that renders a list of teams with search, filter, and pagination functionalities.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Initializes the component by loading the first page of teams.

methods.name: isSearching
methods.description: Determines if the current search or filter criteria are active.

methods.name: getPaginationProps
methods.description: Calculates pagination display info such as start and end counts.

methods.name: loadPage
methods.description: Loads a specific page of team data, either via search or default data fetch.

methods.name: searchTeams
methods.description: Performs a team search with given term and filters, updating state accordingly.

methods.name: searchTeamsDebounced
methods.description: Debounced wrapper for searchTeams to limit API calls.

methods.name: nextPage
methods.description: Loads the next page of team data.

methods.name: previousPage
methods.description: Goes back to the previous page.

methods.name: onSearch
methods.description: Handles search input and triggers data reload.

methods.name: onFilter
methods.description: Handles filter changes and reloads data accordingly.

methods.name: getColumns
methods.description: Defines columns for the data grid.

methods.name: renderManagementMethodText
methods.description: Returns display text for a team's management method.

methods.name: getRows
methods.description: Generates row data for the data grid based on current state.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the component including the data grid with teams.
